pictures.name: SD1-Pool-Amritsar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Punjab in the late 1500s: a wide still pool of water among trees at early morning, workers in turbans carrying baskets of bricks and clay along a narrow causeway to a raised brick platform rising in the middle of the water. Seen only from behind and far away, his face never visible, a Guru in a saffron robe and turban stands at the water’s edge watching the work. Mist, lotus leaves, gold light on the water.

pictures.name: SD2-First-Stone
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. At the edge of the sacred pool, a Sufi saint of Lahore, Mian Mir, a gentle man of about forty with a dark beard touched with grey, a simple patched woolen robe and a white cap, painted with deep respect, kneels and gently sets a single brick into the ground with both hands, eyes calm and kind. Sikh builders and villagers watch with folded hands. Far behind, seen only from behind, a Guru in saffron stands looking on, his face never visible. Morning gold light.

pictures.name: SD3-Four-Doors
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A simple early gurdwara of white plaster and gold in the middle of a pool, reached by a causeway, with arched open doorways on all four sides glowing with warm lamplight from within. From the four directions people walk toward it: a farmer with a plow on his shoulder, a Muslim traveler in a cap, a Hindu woman with a brass tray, a pilgrim with a staff. Dusk, deep blue sky, reflections in the water.

No text, letters, logos or modern objects. Inside a quiet sacred hall lit by oil lamps: a very large handwritten book rests closed on silk cushions under a small embroidered canopy, wrapped in rich saffron and blue cloth, no visible writing. A Sikh attendant in white waves a long white fly-whisk above it. Flowers, incense smoke, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, reverent stillness.

pictures.name: SD5-Ik-Onkar
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters, logos or modern objects. A close, reverent view of the Ik Onkar symbol (the Gurmukhi numeral one joined to a sweeping curve that flies off the top) gilded in gold leaf on a deep blue lacquered panel, glowing in warm lamplight, with soft marigold petals scattered on the ledge below. Only this one sacred symbol, no other writing. Rich, still, luminous.

pictures.name: SD6-Today-Golden-Temple
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style (lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light), a modern scene, main subject in the middle. No text, letters or logos. The Golden Temple in Amritsar at dawn, its gold dome glowing and reflected in the pool. Along the marble walkway, a crowd of every kind of person walks toward it together: an old Sikh man in a blue turban, a young woman in jeans with her head covered by a scarf, a Muslim man in a cap, foreign visitors with orange head-scarves, a family. Soft mist, gold and blue light, peaceful.
